# STEP fixture provenance (ADR 0172, R098.a)

Self-generated corpus of ADR 0172 section 7, written by this repository's own
`sketchyup-ifc-worker --write-step DIR` (the basic OCCT `STEPControl_Writer` in
`src/ifc/step_probe.cpp`), so no third-party licence question:

| file | shape |
|---|---|
| `sketchyup-step-box.step` | a box 10 x 20 x 30 at the origin |
| `inch-units.step` | the box with a hand-written unit block: `GLOBAL_UNIT_ASSIGNED_CONTEXT` applies `CONVERSION_BASED_UNIT('INCH')` (the raw text's first declaration, the millimetre base, stands before it) - the conversion-unit case of the unit policy (ADR 0172, section 2) |
| `sketchyup-step-cylinder.step` | a cylinder of radius 5 and height 20 at the origin |
| `sketchyup-step-assembly.step` | an assembly of the box and the cylinder |
| `spaced-units.step` | hand-written: the unit entities with spaces in the parts (`SI_UNIT ( .MILLI., .METRE. )`) and no shapes — the scan's whitespace-tolerance case |
| `sketchyup-step-placed.step` | the box translated by (5, 10, 15) mm, written with the location (the generator's `SetLocation`); the 7.9.3 writer bakes the location into the coordinates (the ADR 0172 section 7 measurement), so the file's geometry is the box at (5, 10, 15) mm and the reader's location is the identity |
| `sketchyup-step-mirror.step` | the box mirrored about the OX line at the origin (the writer's `gp_Ax1` mirror is the point symmetry: y and z flip), written with `BRepBuilderAPI_Transform` (the det -1 placement is not expressible in the step subset — the mirror is the faces' orientation, ADR 0172 section 7); the tessellated winding is the box's own (the positive signed volume) |
| `sketchyup-step-placed-assembly.step` | hand-written from the assembly fixture: the box component's `AXIS2_PLACEMENT_3D` offset to (50, 0, 0) mm — the ADR 0172 section 4 case (the file's local transformation applied as the instance placement); the 7.9.3 reader preserves it as the label's location, so the import's package node carries the (0.05, 0, 0) m transform and the report counts `placed` |
| `sketchyup-step-instanced.step` | R098.b fixture (a): the two-level assembly with one part (the box) instanced three times at (50, 0, 0), (0, 50, 0) and (0, 0, 50) mm. Written by the XDE writer (`STEPCAFControl_Writer` over the XCAF document, the generator's `--write-step`), which writes the assembly structure — three `NEXT_ASSEMBLY_USAGE_OCCURRENCE`s, each a `CONTEXT_DEPENDENT_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION` of the part under the product's shared placement representation (the `ITEM_DEFINED_TRANSFORMATION`s of the part's `AXIS2_PLACEMENT_3D`s). The XDE read (the import) keeps the three placements as the instance transforms (the shared-mesh design); the basic reader's transfer applies the placements as a chain (its shape's bounding box reaches (60, 70, 80) mm) |

- Generator: `sketchyup-ifc-worker --write-step tests/fixtures/step` (commit `f1ad42f8`,
  the build of 2026-10-23 in `sketchyup-ci-pinned:r097a-ifc`).
- Schema: AP214IS, `AUTOMOTIVE_DESIGN { 1 2 10303 214 0 1 1 1 }`; units declared in
  millimetres (the writer's `WriteUnit` default), angle RADIAN.
- OCCT: 7.9.3.
- SHA-256 at generation (2026-10-23):
  - `sketchyup-step-assembly.step`  5d0d83307dfacb5716368df2ed8ee1d49bca2f5003cd41f9b22aa4bd0fe9bf8c
  - `sketchyup-step-box.step`  d58d273bdf7c0d956f50a84ca793d6edf8ae7b5fc5ac9c1dd0d045eb54aea621
  - `sketchyup-step-cylinder.step`  771866829f584a38d9c05a74b633abe1365ce91f6f5110be937ec979285e5118
  - `inch-units.step` - hand-written (2026-10-24, the review round 2 of the R098.a skeleton):
    the corpus box (the writer's geometry, the writer's header) with the writer's millimetre
    unit entity replaced in the context by a `CONVERSION_BASED_UNIT('INCH')` unit - the shape is
    10 x 20 x 30 inches, 254 x 508 x 762 mm. 00f34a6005943c5257bc1611aa4efd23d3abdf0fb7707c36548e0cbb6ef59e8c
  - `spaced-units.step` — hand-written (no generation); its only content is the header and the three unit entities.
  - `sketchyup-step-placed.step`  a15232f7be4de22e5d6a40affbd1382aec9677d72afb3fb75271bd5e974e611b
  - `sketchyup-step-mirror.step`  56d8558fd4e9abeaf02fddccac049f90e6d53a7ba7a359220a553c3ec09229e6
  - `sketchyup-step-placed-assembly.step` — hand-written (2026-10-24, R098.b): 468943a1e9dd4cd4fd87fd77f032de4c64be0eee58fdcb5e025e054e9ea62bfa
  - `sketchyup-step-instanced.step` — generated 2026-10-25 (R098.b, the generator's `--write-step`, the XDE writer)

The `FILE_NAME` carries a wall-clock timestamp, so a fresh write is not byte-identical
to the committed files; the fixtures are regression **inputs** (`tests/ifc_step_tests.cpp`
probes them), and the test's own determinism check compares a second write's sizes.
Geometry ground truth: the box's bounding box is (0,0,0)-(10,20,30) and its six faces;
the cylinder is one solid with three faces; the assembly is one shape with two solids.
The inch fixture is the same box, the unit in inches: its bounding box is
(0,0,0)-(254,508,762) mm at import (25.4 mm per unit).
The placed fixture's bounding box is (5,10,15)-(15,30,45) mm (the writer bakes the
location); the mirror's is (0,-20,-30)-(10,0,0) mm (the point symmetry about the OX
line); the placed-assembly's is
(-5,-5,0)-(60,20,30) mm (the box at (50,0,0) mm, the cylinder at the origin).
The instanced fixture is one shape with three solids and eighteen faces at the
import (the XDE read: the part shared by the three instances, each a node transform);
its basic-reader bounding box is (0,0,0)-(60,70,80) mm (the placements' chain).
